title: Public Rule Set Schema

tags.description: (Optional) Data kind and domain tags for discoverability (e.g. policy, tariff, program, prosumer, grid, billing)

data_url.description: (Conditionally required) URL where the ruleset is hosted. Either data_url or data_inline must be provided.

data_inline.description: (Conditionally required) The ruleset itself, embedded inline as a string (base64-encoded for binary formats, raw text for rego/jsonlogic). Either data_url or data_inline must be provided.

description.description: (Required) What this ruleset contains and its intended use

data_url_checksum.description: (Conditionally required if data_url is set) Hash value of the data at data_url

data_url_checksum_type.description: (Conditionally required if data_url is set) Algorithm used to compute data_url_checksum. Use 'other' together with data_url_checksum_type_other for algorithms not listed here.

data_url_checksum_type_other.description: (Conditionally required if data_url_checksum_type is 'other') Name of the checksum algorithm (e.g. crc32, xxhash, sha3-224, md5, sha1)

description: Schema for publishing public rulesets on DeDi. Supports both inline data and external data referenced by URL with integrity verification via checksum.
